requirement: Preflight must pass with all blocking checks resolved or explicitly disabled with reason.
Lag class fields, missing/duplicate policies, random seed, trial count, threshold policy, rank policy, and control eligibility must be explicit.
Only arms whose preflight gates pass may be run; A-I remain forbidden in this design update.
Randomization controls require immutable seed policy, trial count policy, and manifest schema before any trials.
Execution outputs must separate baseline, arm results, control manifests, validation, decision cases, risks, and claim boundaries.
No physics or mechanism claims; execution may only report mathematical sufficiency-control outcomes within stated limits.
Stop on validation failure, hash mismatch, pair mismatch, hidden state, unresolved placeholder, or claim boundary drift.
